title: Design critique finding
description: One critique finding. The proposal verb enum has NO 'add': the critic can only subtract. A findings file is a JSON array of these objects.

question.description: The ONE primary constitution question (C1-C8) this finding is grounded in

heuristic.description: Optional secondary grounding, for example nielsen-4, fitts, hick

surface.description: Route, component or element, for example route:/settings or component:CheckoutSummary

diff_hint.description: What to cut or combine, concretely

delta.description: REQUIRED when question is 1, 5, 6 or 8 (flow shape): the measurable improvement

class.description: agent-fixes only when the change is mechanical AND grounded in a rule or decision entry; otherwise the tier 2-4 resolver handles it

severity.description: block = objective regression that hard-fails the build; flag = resolved by the tier 2-3 resolver; nit = at most 2 per run

log_refs.description: Decision entries consulted; never re-raise a resolved finding on an unchanged surface

resolution_tier.description: 1 objective metric, 2 constitution/reference judge, 3 adversarial panel, 4 empirical A/B
